neighbours.label: the token opening the right-hand side of a formula or a chained lookup (FV = PV x (1+r), objects.get)
fire: The general formula is A = P x (1+i) for compound interest.
Future value is given by V = C x (1+g) for this case.
The present value is PV = FV / (1+r) for one year.
The simple formula is T = F x (1+s) for this tax.
quiet: The general rule is that interest is paid at the end.
Future value is mentioned in the last chapter of the book.
The present value is on the first page of the form.
The simple rule is to pay this tax in April.

short: start of a formula's right side
notes: Card: ' =' x8, ' return' x8, ' "' x3, '().' x2, " '" x2, ' ('. Probes: ' (' in a finance formula 0.689, '.get' 0.414, but ' =' in 'output = sos_targets' 0.009, ' self' after return 0.058. A low-confidence guess at what lines up.
